question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be added, and what scopes, redaction, retention, and command-data boundaries must they follow before implementation?
rationale: The implementation direction crosses log disclosure, command-output visibility, dashboard binding, and plugin/widget ownership boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model are reviewed, then implement the widgets against the approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Existing Data
options.body: Allow only a focused `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output widget path, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Route Optional Widgets Outward
options.body: Ask for an external dashboard plugin or ClawHub package unless maintainers sponsor these builtins as bundled OpenClaw dashboard work.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model are reviewed, then implement the widgets against the approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main history signal for the log-tail, protocol, logs page, and bundled-tab surfaces this feature would reuse.
